description: This file contains utility functions for quaternion operations, including conversions between rotation vectors and quaternions, and rotations around principal axes, using Eigen library types.

methods.name: LogSU2
methods.description: Computes the logarithmic map of an SU(2) quaternion, converting it to a rotation vector.

methods.name: ExpSU2
methods.description: Computes the exponential map from a rotation vector to an SU(2) quaternion.

methods.name: rotationVectorToQuaternion
methods.description: Converts a rotation vector to a quaternion representing the same rotation.

methods.name: quaternionToRotationVector
methods.description: Converts a quaternion to its corresponding rotation vector.

methods.name: rotateX
methods.description: Creates a quaternion representing a rotation around the X axis by a given angle.

methods.name: rotateY
methods.description: Creates a quaternion representing a rotation around the Y axis by a given angle.

methods.name: rotateZ
methods.description: Creates a quaternion representing a rotation around the Z axis by a given angle.
